pros: Generous and fully functional free tier.
Cross-platform compatibility (all major OS and browsers).
cons: Less polished UI/UX compared to some competitors.
Occasional autofill inconsistencies on complex websites.
Steeper learning curve for advanced features/settings.
Customer support can be limited for free users.
Some desirable convenience features are locked behind premium.
Desktop application can feel less integrated than browser extension.
